status: proposed; not applied by CI or merge

oscar-chw/qts-platform-showcase.description: Architecture and dated evidence for the tick-data platform I built for a university quant society. Documents versioned Parquet and research access through Arrow, DuckDB and Polars; qts-platform-demo provides an independent synthetic example.

oscar-chw/fatqat-cuda.description: GPU and numerical-computing extension of the open-source FatQat quantum simulator, with CUDA engines, an Apple-GPU runtime and CPU reference comparisons. Inspired by CENG5280; includes a merged upstream CPU-affinity fix.

oscar-chw/agentic-quant-research.description: Quantitative research components: a cited AFML Python library, point-in-time market replay and controlled hypothesis evaluation. LLM proposals are separated from scoring and promotion; the broader research product remains unfinished.

oscar-chw/crypto-desk-blueprint.description: A crypto-first research and trading template with nine typed stages, reusable building blocks and conformance tests. Controlled experiments document where its rules hold and fail. Broader market coverage remains unfinished.

oscar-chw/crypto-trading-pipeline.description: Post-competition crypto pipeline: market data, signals, risk limits and a paper-default broker, with a ccxt adapter. Offline backtests share decision code with the execution loop; synthetic checks do not establish trading performance.

oscar-chw/imc-prosperity-4-shdc.description: IMC Prosperity 4 strategy write-up: Team SHDC placed 904th globally and 18th in Hong Kong. Oscar coded the final two algorithmic rounds. Compares our recorded strategies with nine public team write-ups.

oscar-chw/qts-platform-demo.description: minilake: an independent synthetic-data implementation of the public QTS platform design. Demonstrates immutable raw capture, explicit cleansing rules, dataset versions, repeatable pinned reads and timestamp cutoffs.

oscar-chw/ptcg-ai-battle.description: Kaggle Pokémon TCG AI Battle team entry: imitation learning, search baselines and a separate self-play PPO experiment. Documents package checks, controls, limitations and the recorded team result.

oscar-chw/agent-harness.description: Shared coding-agent rules, memory retrieval and gated work plans, with tool-specific adapters and explicit support boundaries. Public source and recorded checks; guard behavior depends on the tool and release.
